plan: Given my private value of $45, I aim to bid slightly below it to maximize profit while considering rational behavior. With rational bidders, it's likely they won't bid above their value. Thus, I should bid around $44.9 to outbid others valuing slightly less, ensuring I win if others bid close to their values. This approach balances winning probability and profit margin by paying the third-highest bid, assuming others bid close to their values but not above.

Given my value of $41, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Since bids above $41 would result in a loss if I win, I will bid $40.9. This strategy balances between winning the auction and maximizing net profit, assuming other rational bidders will bid close to their values. This bid is slightly below my value to account for the payment of the third-highest bid, ensuring a positive payoff if I win.
